title: THE BAR WARNING SITS UNDER ITS OWN NAME
why: Seen on the 4K Undercroft screenshot of 2026-10-08: his warning under THE LAST POUR (***EXPERIMENTAL FEATURE MAY GLITCH***) is about twice as wide as the name, so even slid in from the wall (v18.96) it reached across under THE STASH and read as that station line. It now shrinks to sit under its own name, never below 70 percent, his words unchanged.
now: The bar warning on the Undercroft floor sits under THE LAST POUR only.
